anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved: both outputs render the initial template with course unset, verdict 'not ready - e2e pending' tied to the assessed head, the merge row withheld with 'Not offered: merge (e2e pending)', no bypass annotation anywhere, and assess/deliver/stop with deliver recommended and nothing performed before a numeric pick. Two regressions in After are worth fixing even though no fact catches them here: the assess row now says 'then approve or stop', which is wrong for an own PR (the author cannot approve, and Before correctly said 'then stop, no repairs' and noted that zero blockers means nothing is posted); and the deliver row dropped the exact head ('watch e2e on abc1234') in favor of 'watch CI until e2e settles', which loosens the exact-head evidence binding the Change says to preserve. Suggested wording: '1. assess - post the review to the PR (zero blockers, so nothing is posted); then stop, no repairs.' and '2. deliver - watch e2e on abc1234, repair anything it turns up, sync with main if needed, repeat until merge is offered. [recommended]'. Keep the 'approve or stop' continuation only on other-author menus.
